calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-26-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Cynthia Herbert, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Victoria Cordeiro in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, Destiny
Kai'vlani Moadams
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined and notice to the father, Sean Moadamus was dispensed by the court.

Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors from Destiny Kai'vlani Moadams to: Destiny Ka'ivlani Cordeiro.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
